digest.component_or_area: rebar-debug skill — defect attribution and RCA
propositions: rebar-debug closes bugs without recording the originating ticket that introduced the defect, making escape rate unmeasurable
the mechanical blame fallback charges defects to the consumer's old ticket when the fix site is not the cause site (producer change creates unmet obligation, consumer never updated)
the skill must trace exact implicated lines through carrier commits and recover the introducing ticket before RCA writeback
the skill must detect and handle four distinct attribution cases: regression, unmet obligation, omission by scope-of-work, and unattributable
bug close must be gated on attribution completion and require explicit --caused-by flag even when the caused_by link was pre-recorded via rebar link
worktree bootstrap must use make worktree instead of bare git worktree add to provision virtualenv, and commands must include worktree venv on PATH
